status: INTERFACE_AMENDMENT_NOEXEC; amends interface-v2 (and the v1 fields it left unchanged) only where listed below; every other v1/v2 rule stays exactly as written

module.relation: this amendment documents the already-written v3 source; same entry build_beta_inputs(request_ref, reader, deadline_check), imports (copy, hashlib, json, math), exports, result schema and non-execution boundary as v2

changes_from_v2.rule: READ_FAILED is terminal for the call. When read_bytes or last_file raises an Exception, or the returned observation does not establish a current completed acquisition, the bridge records READ_FAILED, stops, performs exactly one completion check of the original deadline_check (DEADLINE also recorded if it raises an Exception or returns non-None; a non-Exception BaseException propagates) and then performs no further acquisition, stage evaluation or deadline check; a later None from the checker can never resume acquisition. The result is HELD with no records. A stricter-cap conflict on an already completed cached path stays a non-terminal READ_FAILED (no reader call).

Each path is attempted at most once per call: an attempt marker is stored before read_bytes is invoked; a later use of a path whose attempt did not complete raises READ_FAILED without another reader call or partial evidence. Completed paths are served from the coherent per-call cache exactly as in v2.

The complete candidate result is assembled first; then, unless the call already stopped, the final original-deadline check runs. If it raises or returns non-None, DEADLINE is recorded and a newly assembled HELD result with records and adapter3_inputs null is returned; no acquisition follows. READY is returned only when that final check passed after the candidate existed.

report() is attempted exactly once per call on every path: the attempt is marked before report() is invoked; normal path after evaluation, fallback after _Stop or an ordinary Exception, and, when a non-Exception BaseException (or an Exception outside the evaluation guard) is pending and no attempt was made yet, one protected attempt whose own failure (any BaseException) is caught and retained in per-call state; the pending exception object is then re-raised unchanged.
changes_from_v2.disclosed_limit: On that propagation path no result exists, so the retained secondary report failure is not externally observable; the caller-retained reader stays the authoritative report source (EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES CALLER_RETAINS_GLOBAL_READER_REPORT_AND_OWNERSHIP).
changes_from_v2.amends: interface-v1 consumes_interfaces.reader report usage; READER_UNRESOLVED unchanged for Exception failures

changes_from_v2.rule: Receipt main_wait.pid must typed-exactly equal the int child_pid (bool/float never join); otherwise NESTED_EXIT_UNAVAILABLE.
Receipt artifacts[MAIN capture path].bytes must be an int >= 0 and typed-exactly equal the stream bytes_written; otherwise MAIN_STREAM_UNBOUND.
A MAIN stream monotonic field that is an int too large for float conversion is not finite and yields MAIN_STREAM_UNBOUND, never BRIDGE_INTERNAL_EXCEPTION.

Identity collection blames the originating document: malformed receipt identities and receipt-originated UID/PID conflicts are RECEIPT_INVALID; malformed identities from ack_census or ACK owned_live/unproved_live and any ACK-originated UID/PID conflict (including against a receipt identity) are SUPERVISOR_ACK_INVALID. One shared UID-to-PID map is kept.

freeze_required_coverage additionally includes request.job_dir itself (adapter3 acquires it through reader.directory_names before and after evaluation); its absence from immutable_paths is FREEZE_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE. It is added before the publish-collision check (publish paths are already required to lie outside job_dir).
changes_from_v2.amends: interface-v1 freeze_required_coverage ('expected job_dir/output names' now explicitly includes the directory path)

changes_from_v2.rule: ACK owned_live and unproved_live must typed-exactly equal ack_census.owned_live and ack_census.unproved_live; otherwise SUPERVISOR_ACK_INVALID. Producer evidence: owned_supervisor_v19 line 2614 builds them from the same ack_census lists serialized at 2615/2618. No schema widening.

Receipt cancel must contain the key signal with value null or int; otherwise RECEIPT_INVALID. Producer evidence: owned_supervisor_v19 line 87 CANCEL = {"signal": None, "mono": None}, the handler at 124-133 only assigns keys, line 2542 serializes cancel=dict(CANCEL), and line 2598 reads CANCEL["signal"] directly. SUPERVISOR_CANCEL_SIGNAL:<signum> is then derived from an established key; a missing key is never equated with an explicit null.

unchanged: HELD cause names and order, request/union/freeze/result schemas and key sets, actual evidence derivation other than D5-D7, caps, expectation/observation/context mapping, settlement label vocabulary and interface-v2 C1-C5 sticky-history rules, EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES, never-list and verification boundary
consequence_disclosed: D1 makes the first reader failure stop the whole evaluation, so later independent stage causes are no longer accumulated after a reader failure; the result is HELD in every such case (fewer listed causes, never a less conservative state).
verification_boundary: Written by reading only. No execution/import/compile/AST/tests of the bridge, reader, adapter3 or supervisor19. Grants no runtime, release, canonical-audit or scientific authority.
